title: Map curiosities, round 2: the Downed Saucer, the Graveyard, the Dimensional Gate and the Wishing Well as tile overlays, the neutral Bigfoot and its portrait, their legend icons, and the gate-traverse and coin-splash effects

recipes.promptAddendum: The saucer is big and wide: its flat disc touches the left edge and the right edge of the image, tilted so its left rim is sunk low and its right rim is lifted up. The damage is only long black scorch streaks across the grey metal, never a hole; the glass dome is pale grey, not blue. It has no face.
recipes.negativeAddendum: grass, ground block, dirt block, island, hole, crater, face, eyes, mouth, blue, cyan, lights, magenta, green, alien

recipes.promptAddendum: Bold chibi proportions like the other game pieces: a big round shaggy head, very big round glossy black eyes, a chunky round furry body and short thick legs on two huge flat feet; few fur strands, big simple shapes. It is Bigfoot, not a gorilla.
recipes.negativeAddendum: gorilla, monkey, realistic fur, tiny details, knuckle walking

recipes.editInstruction: Remove all ground: erase the green grass and the brown soil block under the saucer, so the crashed saucer lies directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under it. Keep the grey metal saucer, its pale glass dome, the antenna, the black scorched breach, the bent leg, the outline and the art style exactly the same.

Erase everything except the three grey headstones and the black iron fence: remove the green grass and the brown soil block under them completely, so the headstones and the fence stand directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under them. Keep the three headstones, the moss on them, the black iron fence, the outline and the art style exactly the same.

recipes.promptAddendum: Like a tiny Stonehenge: each standing stone is a tall upright pillar twice as tall as it is wide, with wide open gaps between the stones, and the ring is so wide that its stones touch the left edge and the right edge of the image. The swirl is pure white light with a pale grey shadow tone, never blue and never red. No basin, no rim, no wall and no water.
recipes.negativeAddendum: basin, fountain, well, rim, wall, water, pool, blue, cyan, red, pink, grass, ground block

recipes.promptAddendum: The headstones are pale grey stone #b8b4a8 with a darker grey shadow tone #7c786e, not purple; nothing is drawn under them: no ground, no soil, no grass and no glow.
recipes.negativeAddendum: purple, violet, lilac, soil, ground block, grass plate, glow, fire, lava, orange

recipes.promptAddendum: The stones are tall upright pale grey pillars standing in a row behind and beside the swirl; the swirl is a round whirlpool of pure white light with a pale grey shadow tone standing upright between them, never red and never blue; nothing under them.
recipes.negativeAddendum: red, pink, blue, cyan, disc, plate, ground, candy, peppermint

Keep the white spiral, the rays, the sparkles, the outline and the art style exactly the same.

Erase only the brown and amber ring and base under the white water splash, so the splash and the gold coin float alone on a transparent background with nothing under them. Keep the gold coin, the white water splash, the droplets, the sparkles, the outline and the art style exactly the same.

Remove only the ground: erase the green grass top and the brown soil sides of the block, so nothing is drawn under the graveyard. Keep the three grey headstones and keep every black iron fence bar standing exactly where it is, with its bottom ends on the transparent background; keep the outline and the art style exactly the same.
